description: The Stonewall erects the famous c6-d5-e6-f5 pawn wall with the bishop actively posted on d6. The structure is rock-solid but leaves the e5 square as a permanent target — White attacks it with b3, Ba3, and Ne5 plans while Black prepares the ...f4 break.

lines.description: After 1.d4 f5 2.g3 Nf6 3.Bg2 e6 4.Nf3 d5, Black commits to the Stonewall with the active 5...Bd6 instead of the passive ...Be7, and White castles 5.O-O. White challenges the wall's base with 6.c4 and Black reinforces with 6...c6, completing the c6-d5-e6-f5 formation. White's standard plan is b3, Ba3, and Ne5 targeting the weakened light squares; Black aims for ...Ne4 and the ...f4 pawn storm.
